content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of receipts.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to receipts.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for receipts.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of receipts. You can include thank you notes, store policies, or any other customer information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing receipts using this footer will not be affected.
